title: Text field color-effect not modeled or emitted across keyframes
description: The TextDisplayObject model has no colorEffect field, so alpha/tint tweening on text fields is unsupported. The SymbolInstance move branch in compile.ts (~line 1545) checks colorEffect and emits CXFormWithAlpha; the text move branch (~line 1635) does not. Add colorEffect to TextDisplayObject model and emit CXFormWithAlpha in the text PlaceObject2 move path.
